tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza'i rnam thar lo rgyus dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

oṃ āḥhūṃḥ /bcom ldan kun bzang sangs rgyas kun gyi rje/ /rgyal ba rigs gsum rigs 'dzin chen po dang*/ /snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba yongs la byin gyis rlobs/ khyad par bdag blo'i mun sel rin po che/ /thugs dgongs klong yangs kun tu bzang dang mnyam/ /rnam thar mdzad spyod dam pa rin chen nyid/ / sku drin mi 'khor drin can nyid la 'dud/ /yi dam lha tshogs ma dang mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /chos skyong bka' srung pho mos bar chad sol/ /kye ma bdag 'dra'i ban lda ོ ma gzhon rgyal gyi/ /lo rgyus bri bar 'os pa ma yin kyang*/ /gus ldan slob mas yang yang bskul ba'i phyir/ /cal col 'ga' zhig 'bri 'o byin gyis rlobs/ /de la spyir mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ khyad par du lho 'dzam bu gling gser gyi bye ma brdal ba lta bu 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di dar bar mdzad pa po ston pa nyid dang mtshungs pa dpag tu med pa byon zhing*/ khyad par du bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams mun pa'i smag 'thibs pa dang 'dra ba 'dir/ chos kyi rje rin po che gsum gyi sku drin la bstan pa 'dzin skyong srung bar mdzad pa sprul pa'i sku grangs las 'das pa byon zhing*/ de dag gi rnam par thar pa sh+lau ka res kyang yid tshim pa dag gi mdzad pa la/ yid phrogs pas bri bar mi nus te/ ston pa dang bstan pa'i rim pa rnams la mos gus cung zad yod pa yi ger bkod pa yin gyi/ dad pa can sgyid mi lug pa'i phyir/ de la bod kyi yul du rdo rje gdan lta bu dpal lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bsam yas dang nye ba'i 'on zhes bya ba dge bcu tshang ba'i dbus mda' bar gsar zhes bya ba/ o rgyan pad+ma rin po che nas brgyud pa'i sngags pa'i rigs rgyud ngo ma zhes bya ba/ pha jo sras bsod nams dpal zhes bya ba dang*/

shākya khri mgon zhes bya ba/ ag tshar can gyi bu mo khyer tsha 'bum me zhes bya ba gnyis la nged bu tsha ming srid lnga las/ che ba ni a lce ldan ne/ de 'og phu bo bsod nams 'bum bya ba khyim 'dzin du bcug pas/ chos byas te bya bral zhig byung ba la ti se la bros so/ de 'og bdag thar pa rgyal/ de 'og nu bo 'tsho byed/ de 'og sṛng mo 'ber mo bya ba yin/ bdag chung ba'i skabs su gso shin tu dka' ba byung zer/ a khu dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa bar gsar pa'i tsha bo yin/ lo bzhi tsam lon dus lug gi bal breg pa la khong gi gos ma bshu zhes smra / dad pa dang snying rje cung zad yod/ lo drug bdun lon tsam na/ phas zhag 'gar yi ge khrid pas 'byor klog tshun chad bslab/ rjes nga rang gis sbyong bas shes so/ /gshar ma dpe gog khyer nas bltas shing bris pa dang mtshungs par shes par byung*/ rtsal yig 'og le gcig shes te/ phyis mkhas pa gzhan cung zad bsten nas bslab/ las la dpe gog 'dra ba khyer nas yi ge'i ri mo spyangs/ gtsug tor la sogs pa'i mdo phran cung zad bton/ pho mchin gyi nad bu cung zad kyi rkyen gyis zhang po slob dpon cig yod pas/ gtum mo cung zad bsgoms pa dang*/ bde mchog yig bdun gyi bsnyen pa dum re byas pas rtags phran de 'dra mthong*/ der ma sdug ma shi nas phas kong po na mar khrid de/ 'og shod kyi mtho steng dgon par bla ma dgyes rdor bya ba las kye rdor dang bde mchog gi dbang thob/ /de nas yar la log nas pha bu gsum gyis g.ye dang sgom por 'khyams/ ngas g.yer sngags pa gcig gi 'phags pa brgya tshar gcig bton/ bla ma nub bya ba bgres po gcig la rta mgrin lha bzhi'i dbang zhus/ khong pha bu gnyis kyis g.yer/ ma bsdad par sgom po stod du song yod pas rjes su snyags/ phas rtsig gzo 'dra byed kyin 'dug / ngas lo dgu lon dus na 'gron gyi dgon par mkhan po gtsang po bya ba 'dul ba dang*/

spyod 'jug /brtag gnyis la sogs pa mkhyen pa zhig la/ yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen byas btsun par bsrungs/ slob dpon dge slong gcig las rde'u'i dka' thub dang*/ spyan ras gzigs gang par phug mo che nas thon pa'i lung bag tsam zhus/ rde'u'i dka' thub byas pas shig nad tshabs che la dar drag pa khong nas shig kha nas yar byung*/ gos ras glegs gcig gi shan 'gag ran pa zhig las med pas cung zad nyen na yang chos kho na la mos pas legs par byung*/ der pha 'das ltas bzang po byung*/ nga lo bcu gcig lon pa zhig gis nu bo lo drug lon pa zhig skyong dgos pa byung*/ de dus rje o rgyan pa e na phyags phebs yod pa thos pas/ nga rang gcig pus mjal du phy-in pas/ gnyal stod kyi lung la gcig gi phur rjes slebs/ chos 'brel tsam thob/ zhag gcig bsdad nas nu bo khrid nas zhang po can du bskyal/ bdag slob dpon tshul rgyal bya ba zhig gis khrid nas gdan sa phag mo grur phyin/ de dus lo bcu gnyis tsam lon/ mkhan po yer pa dang slob dpon mnga' ris pa gnyis las dge tshul gyi bslab pa blangs/ bla ma lha khang pa bya bas/ phag mo khams gsum ma'i brda bzhi'i byin rlabs kyi chos sgo phyi rin po che grags ye ba dpal phag mo grub pa'i sprul pa de las rje nā ro pa'i chos drug rnying ma dang*/ chos rje 'bri gung pa'i 'khrungs chos zab chos dang bcas pa lo lnga'i bar la zhus/ de'i bar skabs su bla ma 'tsher stengs pa bya ba zhig las brtag gnyis rngog lugs shes pa tsam du sbyangs/ bla mas gsungs pa ni min/ nga'i rtogs pa bskyed rdzogs la 'byams pas/ de gnyis bsdur na skad cig ma'i rtogs pa bskyed rim/ de'i rang bzhin mi dmigs pa de rdzogs rim du 'dug snyam pa zhig byung ste rtogs pa ma skyes so/ /de'i gong du yul na yod dus chung dus a ne slob dpon ma zhig yod par 'dug pa'i be'u bum gcig

/phas khyer byung bas 'khor 'das dbyer med bya ba zhig 'dug nas de la bsam pas rtogs pa cig 'char la khad pa zhig byung ba la/ de nas the tshom gyis song*/ byis pa rnams rtse ba'i sar bsam gtan sgom pa gang bzang 'gran no byas/ lung pa'i phur shing len du phyin pas/ brag phug gam bya skyibs 'dug pa der bsdad na ri khrod kyi bag chag gcig gda'/ gzhan yang bla ma la kyai rdor gyi phran bu 'dra ba dang*/ rtsa ltung dang*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa la sogs 'ga' re zhus/ skabs su dpon sangs she bya ba lha mkhas la dad pa che ba zhig gi sar lha bslabs ma ṇi yig drug re mang du bsgrangs pas/ nam mkha' ni min sa gzhi la khang bu legs po'i nang na spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa zhig bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal ba yang rmis/ de'i bar skabs shig tu slob dpon bya ston bya ba'i phyag phyi la/ gra phyir bla ma khyung nag shākya dar las phur pa rtsar thung jo mo lugs dang*/ gshin rje gshed dang*/ dgra nag tshe bdag kun gyi dbang kun gyi dbang rgyud gdams ngag las kyi gshin rje'i zhal gyi ngo sprod tshun chad thob/ phyag rdor ras chung ba'i lung bag tsam yang phag mo grur zhus/ yang de dus se gso pa mkhan po rin po che dang mjal/ slob dpon rje tsha ba bya ba las mgon po phyag bzhi pa rga lo'i lugs zhus/ phag mo grur yang phag mo gru pa'i zhal myur lha dang*/ dar dmar ma zab chos su sgrub skor dang dbang 'ga' zhus/ bla ma rngog pa'i kye rdor gyi yum bka' de dkon pa yin zer/ mched grogs mang po'i zla la zhus/ ma yā rngog lugs chos drug dang*/ mkha' spyod ma dkar mo zhus/ chos rje rang gis bskos pa'i gdan sa pa/ bla ma dar ma mgon las rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod zhus/ slon dpon dbon po bsod nams rdo rje las kun rigs chags lo lugs dang*/ sman bla'i mdo chog dang*/ don zhags dang dngul chu'i gdams pa drang srong gzhung skyes kyis mdzad pa zhus/

slob dpon rgyal ston las nā ro pa'i 'grel chen gyi lung zhus/ bla ma ras pa dang slob dpon mkhas pa bsod nams rdo rje las drag sgrub dang rtsa rlung gi gdamasapa'i gnad gcig zhus/ chos rje pa las rgyud bla ma'i lung dang*/ ras chung bsnyen sgrub lag len/ do ha la sogs lung mang du zhus/ de'i bar skabs gcig tu 'on du yong ba gcig dang phyis dbyar gcig gang po sgang du bsdad pa gcig ste gnyis la sogs pas lo bdun bsdad kyi ring la / lam 'bras zha lugs khrid kyi lung nas zhi byed mo lugs/ phyag rgya chen po cha gnyis ma/ zhal gyi bdud rtsi dam la sogs mi g.yo ba skor gsum/ 'dul ba min pa mkhyen tsho ma'i bar zhus/ de nas mtshur phur bsdad yod dus su chos rje pa 'khrungs pa'i ya mtshan thengs gcig gnyis thos/ de nas gra pa'i zhi byed pa ti se la phyin pa dpon g.yog gnyis gyis glang gor du chos rje pa lo bdun lon pa zhig dang mjal nas/ chos gsungs rnam thar rgyas pa gcig 'dug pa de khong la bskur nas stod lung mdo bar song zhig gsungs pa 'dug pa las/ khong gnyis byung rnam thar la/ la las dad log byas/ bdag sngar nas mos pa'i stobs kyis nam la bris/ khong gnyis zhag gsum las/ bsdad du ma btsud bar phud/ nged rnam thar la bltas shing mos pa drag po skyes pas/ rmi lam ngo mtshar can btud ma mang po byung nas/ nga rang gis dang blangs byas te la stod du phyin ding ri glang 'khor bltas/ bhu cwad phyi na dge tshul mdzad ma thag dang mjal/ grub chen pa dang*/ chos rje pa gnyis la bla ma'i zhu yig dang phyag rten yod pa rnams phul thugs la 'dog par mdzad/ drung si ba bsnyung pa'i bsnyung g.yog pa bdag gis byas/ nga rang la'ang 'gos nas mig de shor byung*/ de dus nam zla sos ka yin pa dang*/ na bas chos ma thob/ de nas mtshur phur phyin lan sbyar/ bla ma o rgyan pa gong du gdan drangs pa'i zhar la mtshur phur tshur byon/

gnyan ras la drung gis snying tig zhus pa'i zhar la thob ste mkhas/ drung nas g.yor po gung gsal du gdan drang pa'i phyags phyi la yod pa/ bla ma sgom pa bya ba'i bzang po de la ngas mdo sde rgyan gyi lung dang*/ rmi lam 'brel ba gsum ldan zhus/ mtshur phur slebs pa'i dus su drin can me long pa'i thugs rje'i thag pas bzung ste lho brag mkhar chu nas 'bri gung gcung rin po che'i slob ma sgom chen gsum la/ ri mo de la nan chag gcig slobs la nga can du shog gsung byung yang*/ chos rje pa sku lus ma rgyas/ khong drag shos bka' chags sdang byas pas khong blos ma thengs par lo gcig lhag lus/ lar mtshur phu la stod dang*/ sa skyar yug gcig bsdad pa brtsis pas lo bcu gcig tsam thos bsam las sgom pa cher ma byung*/ grub chen pa dang chos rje pa gnyis mjal 'dod pa rkyen cig gis ma mjal/ de nas sham po gangs su drin can me long pa dang mjal/ yar klung du slebs nas/ gra phyir bla ma dge slong sngar nas zab chos zhus pa gcig yod pas/ dgon chung zhig tu dgun thog gcig bsdad de chos lhag ma zhus/ yar klung du bla ma nam mkha' ba las gsang skor gnad kyi ngo sprod zhus/ skal ldan dgon par bla ma rin po che chos kyi seng ge las kyang*/ slob dpon rin chen seng ge nas brgyud pa'i gsang gnad kyi ngo sprod dang*/ mkhar chu dam pa'i hūṃ skor la sogs pa zab chos zhus/ de dus yang drin can gyi thugs rjes bzung ste/ gsungs shog rten dang bcas pa bskur nas bla ma skal ldan pa 'byon pa'i zla la cis kyang shog gsungs nas phyin/ de nas thugs rjes bzung nas lto gos chos gsum gyis bskyangs/ rdzogs pa chen po snying tig gi gtsos pa'i zab chos dang phyag dpe bzhugs so cog gi lung mdzad de/ shin tu thugs rjes bzung*/ bla ma mdo ras pas bzhengs pa'i bum chung gi khang pa'i nang la dbyar ril po gnyis su ri mo byas mkhar chu bzang por 'dug pas khams 'dus bag tsam yang byung*/

khyad par du shig nad drag po dgun thog gcig byung*/ de dus gos kyang ri 'gag zad po gcig /zla gam zhan pa gcig /ras thang theng po zhig dang gsum la nyin gos mtshan gos yin/ rtogs pa'i tha lo go yul thebs gcig kyang skyas/ yi ge du ma gcig byas nas gzigs su phul bas/ bla ma kun dga' bas khyod zhib par 'dug gsungs nas mnyes/ de nas bdag gis bla med chen po 'di ster bar mi yong*/ sgom chen pa chos kyis phongs pa re re tsam byung na/ khregs gcod 'di byed par zhus pas/ khyed 'ong ba kun gyis byas pas chog pa la mi byed mi 'ong ba kun gyis byed par 'dug gsungs nas rjes gnang yang thugs rjes bzung*/ dus skabs shig tu chos zhu tsho gcig 'dug pa'i dbang zhar la mtshams la yod pa la shogs gsung nas dbang tshar bas tshogs kyi rjes la/ la la gyes song ba zhig la/ bla ma rin po che'i dbu'i steng gi nam mkha'i thad sor zur na mgon po phyag bzhi pa chung ngu zhig bzhugs pa mthong*/ de dang dus mtshungs su gzims khang gi sgo'i thad na yar gzigs pas bzhug gdan legs po ma dran/ ma sngags kyi srung ma dpal e ka dza ṭi mthing mo zhing dbyug dang spyang mo bsnams pa/ sku thog gnyis brtsegs dang mnyam pa gcig bzhugs pa mthong*/ de nas yug gcig na sgo'i phyi rol gyi sgo phug gi 'og na las mkhan khrag ral can gnyis ka mar bltas nas khrag gi mtsho chung gcig nas lag pa gnyis kyis bcus nas 'thung ba mthong*/ de kun zhus pas gong ma gnyis la ci yang mi gsung*/ phyi ma de la dam nyams gcig 'chi ba'i rtags yin gsungs/ gzhan lha zhal dang nyag nyog ra rim mthong*/ lha che shos de bag tsam mthong ba lags/ de res lo lnga bla ma 'du 'bral med par bsten/ sngar lo gsum dang brgyad bsten/ da dus mkhar chu'i nub ngos smad na o rgyan gyis bzhugs pa'i snyug tshal spug bya ba dkyil 'khor zla gam yod pa zhig 'dug /de lam la cung zad nye/

de'i zhogs gcig na bar chod byed pa chu 'phyar nas 'bab pa la rlung brgyab pas skad shin tu 'jigs pa sna tshogs 'ong ba/ nags tshal 'thug po yod pa mi ma yin gyi skad nyin mo yang sgra sgrog pa zhig tu dgun thog gcig nga rang gcig pus dge sbyor byas pas dge sbyor yang 'phel bar byung*/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i rtags rkyang 'ga' zung byung*/ shes rab kyi rtsa kha yang skyes nas mgur ma'ang 'ga' byas/ de nas drin can bla ma ma gshegs tsam la yar klung du 'ong*/ tshar steng gi dgon chung de btab/ de'i dgun stod la las yur ma thon/ la las mgo la ma byed pa de la sku gshegs pa sems kyis tshor te/ nga rang gcig pus mkhar chur slebs la khad du phyin/ grong pa'i lho brag stod las ma thos/ mar la phyin pas sa stegs kyi thad khar bla ma'i sras pos mkhar chu'i bya ba tshar nas sgrags ngos su byon pa dang mjal nas gra'i phu tshun chad phyags phyir 'ong*/ snyung lus pur sbyangs pas rten byon pa/ zhal chems tshan pa gnyis la sogs pa gnang*/ yar lung du dgon chung der zla mchod gcig btsugs te bsdad/ de nas yun mi ring ba la skyo ba bsangs pa la gnas gtad la tsā ri rnying mar gnas chen du bdag rang gcig pur bsgrod de phyin/ lar g.yu mtsho bskor bar khral dang dad 'bul bsdus/ lam sna ba/ 'gro mgon dkon gnyer/ gtor gnyer/ ma rgan/ gling sgrub la sogs chu gdan chu gas dum dang bcas pas bskor bar gda'/ bdag rang gcig pus chu stan chu zhwa gcig yod/ tswa ri yul chung tshun chad ston pa grogs po gcig yod/ de nas la chung gcig brgal ba na krig mo lha'i ne ring bya ba'i lung pa na/ rang byung rdo sku'i mchod rten chung chung gcig gda' ba la 'ja' tshon zug pa mthong*/ 'gro don nam de yong zer ba gda'/ de nas ka la dung mtsho bya ba nas la chung brgal ba na lha mo la bya ba'i gsham na/ dpal lha mo rang byung rgyal mo re ma tī chu'i zhal khebs yod pa mthong*/
de nas dpal shel gyi ri bya ba'i gangs 'dabs gcig la 'dzegs phyin pas lam cung zad nor nas char lhags kyis cung zad nyen/ de nas ma mgon gyi bla mtsho dang mtsho mo 'od 'bar ba bya ba 'dug

/ rgyus med pas brag phug yod pa ma rnyed par zhag gcig gnas kyis cung zad nyen/ de nas la chung gcig brgal ba'i sar g.yu mtsho zlum po bya ba grags pa can der slebs/ der las dag pa kun gyis mthong snang gzigs snang mang po 'char bar yod par gda'/ ban ldom bdag la nam mkha' rnam dag sna sprin gyis ma bsgribs pa ston kha'i nam mkha' lta bu/ 'og na mtsho shin tu dngas ba rnyog pa dang nya lcibs/ sngo ldum 'bag 'bog la sogs pa med pa shin tu dngas pa la me long g.ya' dag pa'i nang lta bu/ de gnyis kyi bar ram mtsho'i nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon shin tu dngas pa ri mo gcig thur la zug pa de gsum dus gcig la der slebs ma thag gi nyi ma snga dro dang po la mig gi yul du mngon sum du mthong ngo*/ /der phug pa gcig tu zhag gsum bsdad cung zad gnyan par 'dug / bdun la sogs pa zhag 'ga' bsdad snyam pa la/ rgyags phye ma theg pas lam nor na snyam ma bsdad/ de nas g.yu mtsho skyog mo dang*/ stag tshang rong bya ba shin tu gnyan zer ba zhig tu bar zhag gcig bsdad/ yang lam dum gcig nor bas gangs yod pa'i lung chung gcig tu nyi ma 'phyis pas phug pa ma rnyed par mtshan yal le char pas nyen/ de nas ngo mtshar rong bya ba nas dkrig mo lha'i ne ring du zhag gcig bsdad/ de nas sngar gyi thams cad dgun gzhugs byed pa'i gzhi chen mor slebs/ zhag bcu lhag tsam bsdad/ de nas byar smad du phyin/ bla ma dharma bya ba bdag gi bla ma'i mched gcig 'dug pa des thugs la btags/ mdzo 'am skye dman ma brten pa gcig bya snyam pa lags zhus pas mi 'thad pas chos kyi rje yab sras dri gsungs pa yan chad byon/ de 'dra sogs kyi bslab bya mdzad/ de nas tshar steng du gzhi byas/ mtshur phu dang se gsob tu mkhan po rin po che'i drung du phyin/ snying tig spyo da gzer lnga rnams la mnyes pa'i gsung byon pas dpe bris lung dang bcas pa phul/ mtshur phur chos rje la rgyud bcu bdun la sogs kyi lung byas/

skabs sha ི ga la stod du grub chen pa dang mjal ba la phyin pas lam kha ra/ sa cha shangs su the ba'i lang 'gro bya ba'i yul na/ lo brgyad cu tsam bzhes pa'i lha chen 'khor ban bya ba'i sngags pa gcig las/ gshin rje tshe bdag gi skor dang sna 'ga' zhus/ de nas yar nub phyogs la chung zhig brgal ba na mtshar bya ba'i lung chung zhig tu gsang skor gyi bdag po lce sgom nag por grags pa de'i yang tsha yod par 'dug pa dang*/ lam 'dzol nas/ kha ོ nga lce sgom gyi ma ga tsha'i brgyud pa'i zhal ngo slob dpon sgom pa bya ba bsgres po zhig las gsang skor snyan brgyud ngo spra ོ da/ mkhas pa bi ma la'i bsam gtan mig gi sgraun me'i khrid rdzogs pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga las 'phros pa'i lha rgyug 'dre rgyu yan chad kyi dpe bris / lung thams cad ma lus par zhus/ de nas la stod ding ri snam ru slebs/ la stod gzhon dga'i gdung brgyud/ dpon po dbang sgrub bya ba las/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos dang gsang skor gyi man ngag bsam gtan mig gi sgron me thig le phyi nang la slaub pa yod pa rnams zhus shing gnang*/ lo stod du thengs gnyis po de las ma phyin/ mar lam gtsang grom pa sa skya ba'i thad na bla ma bkra lung ba bya ba bzang po gcig la phyin/ yang lan gcig der gtad nas phyin pa'i lan gnyis la/ chos bcom ldan 'das gshin rje dgra nag gi dbang rdzogs pa/ rgyud gdams ngag ma lus pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga tshe dpag med mdo lugs kyi cho ga /bla ma gnyan la tshem bu'i spyan ras gzigs kyi snyan brgyud/ snyan brgyud yi gai bzhi pa/ thugs rje chen po'i gsang sgrub kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang la sogs pa zab pa 'ga' zhig zhus/ yang gtsang gi rgyang gying dkar bya ba yod pas rgyang dkar gyi dgon par gsang skor snyan brgyud kyi rtsa ba khong du 'dug pas/ yang slob dpon ye shes mgon la brgyud pa gtugs so/ snye mdor rje rin po che ba sku mched gsum 'dzom pa las brgyud pa phyi mo'i dbang gi gdams pa/

rgod tshang pa'i khrid chen brgyad/ bla ma kun dga' ba las kun byed rgyud gsum brgyud pa lde mig cha bzhi la sogs pa zhus/ dol gyi spong rar/ slob dpon gzhon nu las sngags kyi sngags gnad/ mdo byi ru bla ma sangs rgyas 'bum las a ro'-i khrid mo cher grags pa'i gdams ngag /'khor ba rtsad gcod ma lus zhus/ rgyang du slob dpon bon ston las sngags srung sngags gnad phug ron bcu gsum/ rdzogs chen bon lugs/ lung drug rnams zhus/ de nas gzhi 'tshal steng nas chos rje'i gsung gis nga yang kong por gdan 'dren yod khyod kyang shog gsungs nas 'phral du mjal 'phrad byas/ rtsa ri gsar mar nged gnyis kyis gnas skor gcig byas/ g.yu mtsho la dgun gzhug lta bu ston kha nas/ zla ba ril po bdun ngo gcig dang brgyad gdan thog gcig tu skad thos kyis bskor nas mi gcig med par gcig pur bsdad/ 'dre rtog gis cho 'phrul nyams/ rmi lam gsum mang bar byung*/ 'dzam bha las dngos grub lta bu'i ltas phyag g.yas pas de byin/ gzhi bdag 'dra bar 'dug pa gcig gi rgyab phyogs ngos su bdag la ral gri rnon po shubs dang bcas pa rku thabs su byin nas chos klod de gyis bya ba zhig byung*/ dgongs mo sbyin bsreg cung zad byas pa'i nub mo gzhi bdag gha ya ngha ra khong rang gis khul dang*/ pho brang gcig 'dug bar nged gsum la bsnyen bkur byas/ kho rang gi rta tshun chad bstan de'i klu bsen mo gcig pho rigs gcig gis dngos su bar chad drag po brtsams/ mtsho lnga yod pa'i lho phyogs kyi mtsho che ba zhig gi steng du 'od lnga'i lbu ba ser po phub tsam pa zha ིga yar ded mar ded phar ded tshur ded gcig la gcig thim/ yang thugs rje de dang 'brel ba 'ga' mthong*/ de nas mtshams phyir thon nas glang po sgang dang*/ gnas pa'i ri khrod rnams su bla ma dbon pos dbu mdzad ri pa phal mo che rnams la gsang ba snying tig gi mgo byas pa mang du bshad nas yar dwags por 'ongs

/ sngar lam rgya btang na yang 'thad zer ba byung yang ma brtag pa'i las gnyen mi 'thad par 'dug pas ma byas/ da res thong zer nas bdag rkyen cung zad byed mi 'dra byung bas/ thog mar yu ba*/ nga la bya ba'i mi ngan gyi gdug rtsub kyis bgrod dka' bas/ de la lam rgya btang*/ de nas rim gyis dwags po'i lung pa dang*/ e ror tshun chod la lo gsum dang zla ba bzhi btang*/ gtso bor bla ma'i byin brlabs dang rang gi smon lam dang dam can mthu chen rnams kyi byin rlabs las legs par byung*/ de dag gi gong du yon bdag gi skye mched la brten nas/ dgon par gzhis kha pas dmag brgyab nas bcom yang*/ slob grogs bsdus nas mthu gtad kyang cher ma byas/ sham po gangs la bsdad dge sbyor yang 'phel skyid nas yod tsa na/ rtse zhing pa'i sras mo a 'bum kyis rtse zhing du bos/ ram gyi phu dang brag log snyug log gcig la zhag nyi shu tsam sdod dgos pa byung*/ dbon mo phag mo de drin can rin po che'i slob ma'am yon bdag gi rtsa ba yin pas/ slob dpon ri pa gcig dang gnyis kyis ba ོ sa / zhag gcig gtsang khang du bsnyen bkur byas gser zho gang byin nas rgyangs ba gcig tu byon dang zer nas rig pa can ma yin yang*/ yar nub phyogs su spyan g.yas pa'i ma hā re g.yar nas lo shas sdod gzhi byas/ khong yon mchod gnyis kyis thugs la btags pas da dung 'brel zab pa de lags so/ /nub phyogs su yang ri khrod 'ga' btab pa la/ byang sa ba'i bde chen steng la sogs par yun du sdod sa ma byung yang ri khrod 'ga' zung btab/ kong po na yang grub smad kyi mthong smon la sogs pa 'ga' btab pa dang*/ dwags po sto da na yang bsam grub gling lhun grub rdzogs la sogs pa btab/ sems can la phan ci thogs kho na byas pa lags mod/ yang ma hā ri na sdod dus dpon g.yog bdun tsam gyis 'bri gung gi rgyab/ te sgro'i o rgyan rin po che'i bzhugs gnas kyis gtso byas pa'

ི ri khrod lung stong 'ga' bskor te/ jo mo gangs dang jo mo kha rag dang*/ shangs kyi zab bu'i gter khung man chad bskor bas de lo khams shin tu bzang ba gcig byung*/ de yan chad ni chos phyogs su dad pa'i ngal dub kyis cung zad dka' bar byung yang*/ dal 'byor gyi lus chud mi za bar bya ba dang*/ theg pa chen po'i tshul mi 'dor bar mos par byas ba'i rnam gzhag yin mod/ 'di ltar bkod pa'i dngos don slob ma rnams kun la tshe 'di'i 'brel thag 'khri ba bcad/ bla ma dkon mchog gi phyogs su blo sna kyur gyis bsgyur bas chos las ma bral bar/ gong ma'i rnam thar la yid smon pas sdod sa ri khra ོ da dang*/ lung stongs su byed pa/ tshe 'di'i dri ma ngan pas ma gos pas chos brgyad dang bral ba/ snying po don gyi dgongs pa'i dran 'dzin las ma yengs par/ chos spyod khyad du mi gsod par sems bskyed kyi rjes mthun sems can nye rir med pa la phan ci thogs byed pa dang*/ don chen po yal bar mi 'dor bar brtson pa/ gong ma'i gdung gsob pa/ tshe 'di'i mthun 'jug spong pa la sogs pa'i chos phyogs su gzhol ba re tsam 'ang srid mtha' ma bkag pas de lta bu'i rkyen bskul du song na legs/ log sred can gyi lag tu 'grims nas log par bltas pas skyabs gnas 'dor ba'i nyes pa spong ba'i phyir sba bar rigs so/ /dpal kun tu bzang po nas dngos cag bdag yon mchod dam nyams gyi dri mas gos pa med cing*/ brgyud pa skyon lnga'i sel med pas dam tshig 'di la brtson pas sgrims mdzod/ tshe 'di'i chos ltar bcos pa'i bya ba rtsol ba chen pos lder so la sogs sku gzugs/ gsung rab la sogs bzhengs/ bsod nams mang po bsags na/ rang nyid lhun grub chos skur son nas sprul pa du mas 'gro don rgyun mi chad pas/ smin grol mdzad par gda' bas/ dben pa'i gnas su skabs don gal chen de la don du gnyer na/

rang gzhan gyi don lhun grub tu gzi gas gda' bas de rnams kyis thugs dgyes par mdzad 'tshal/ bdag 'dra'i ban ldom ku ma rā dza la/ / kun dgas yang dang yang du bskul ba dang*/ / gzhan yang re re gnyis gnyis de skad zer ba dang*/ da lo'i skabs su rtsar sdod cing g.yog po gus par byed pa rin rgyal gyis yang yang bskul nas bris pa'o/ /'di 'dra'i yig ge 'khyams pa na/ /mos gus mi byed sdig pa bsogs/ /dad can sun 'byin skyon bsal yin/ /'di bris dge ba ci yod pas/ /sems can sangs rgyas nyid du shog / cal col ring mo zhes bya ba mos gus can gyis gtso bor bskul ba'i phyir/ stag lo dbyar zla ra ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin mor bris pa 'di yongs su rdzogs so/ / // dge'o/ / bla ma dam pa ku ma rā dza de nyid/ dwags po dang lung gi phur sku 'das ba'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ phyi rabs kyi don du 'das rjes gsungs pa/ yi ger btab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sprang po bya bral gzhon nu rgyal pos gdams pa ni/ /e ma ngas ni ngo bo skyong ba de dang rang rig rtsa gdar bcad/ / dmigs med spros bral mtha' dang bral bar rtogs/ /chos sku'i ngang du ku ma rā dza 'chi/ /rang bzhin dbyings la lta stangs rig pa gcun/ /zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor thig le nyag gcig rtogs/ /longs sku'i ngang du ku ma rā dza 'chi/ / thugs rjes sems can gzhan phan gtso bor byas/ /shar grol rig pa chos nyid ma dang 'phrad/ /sprul sku'i ngang du ku ma rā dza 'chi/ /ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas dri ma med/ /gzhir snang rang gdangs dang po'i byung sar thim/ / lhun grub sbubs su ku ma rā dza 'chi/ /nga yi zab don snying po'i gdams pa rnams/ /bcud du dril nas nyams len snying po bstan/ /bdag gi rjes 'jug skal ldan snying gi bu/ /ji ltar bsgrubs kyang chos dang mthun par mdzod/ /nga yi gtam gzhug 'gro kha'i tshig 'di rnams/ /phyi rabs don du snying nas mos la ston/

/tig tig gang la yang mi 'dug /lar snang ba 'di gtad pa med pa gcig yin/ skyag pa ngas drin can rin po che/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ha ha phaṭa/ ces gsungs nas thugs 'pho ba'i tshul bstan te/ sa chen po 'di rab tu g.yos/ nam mkha' la sil snyan gyi sgra rang grags/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub ste 'gro ba rnams ngo mtshar gyi sa la bkod/ a+thi+-i ༄༅/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥgu ru ku ma rā dza la na mo/ /gdod ma'i mgon dang rnam dbyer mi phyed cing*/ /rig 'dzin chen po bi ma mi tra dngos/ /yon tan rgya mtsho nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /chos rje ku ma rā dza'i zhabs la 'dud/ / dpal ldan tshogs gnyis yon tan rdzogs pa'i gtso/ /'jig rten gsum mgon chos rje bla ma la/ /dad pa'i gdung shugs g.yo bas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /snying nas mchi ma 'khrugs pas skyabs su 'chi/ /sku tshe snga ma'i snga ma dpag med nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro la thugs rje'i spyan dbye bas/ /de ring 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gyur cig/'dir yang sa steng 'jig rten rgyan gyur mchog /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad cing*/ /rlabs chen spyod pa dam pa'i khur bsnams te/ /sna tshogs mdzad pas 'gro kun bde la bkod/ /grags dkar yon tan phreng bas gnam sa khyab/ /slar yang rtag par 'dzin rnams gdul bya'i phyir/ /tha ma'i mdzad pas shar phyogs dang lung du/ /chu mo lug lo'i ston zla tha chung la/ /mi rtag mya ngan 'da' 'tshul bstan par gyur/ /rgyan gyur 'jig rten bla ma de gshegs te/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen dbyings su stor/ /bstan pa rin chen dpag bsam shing chag ste/ / gru chen 'jig rten bla ma de ring zhig /rnam pa kun tu lha rdzas char 'bab cing*/ /'od zer lnga ldan ye shes snang ba gsal/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten ngo mtshar yid g.yos te/ / mkha' 'gros mchod sprin sil snyan sgra bsgrags te/ / sngon med snang ba ngo mtshar dpag med cing*/ /spos bsung dri dang dus min rol mos gang*/

/nyin mtshan khor yug 'od lnga'i mdangs shar bas/ / byang chub snying por 'gro ba 'dren par mdzod/ /sa 'di rir bcas zhi bas cher g.yos shing*/ /nags tshal ljon shing 'dud pas phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me tog chu gtsang 'dzum pa'i mdangs gsal zhing*/ / bya dang ri dwags sgra 'byin skyabs su 'gro/ /mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'du bas sdun bsus te/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du gshegs par gyur/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma da ེ ring 'dir nub ste/ /'tsho byed sman gyi rgyal po gshegs kyi med/ /thar lam ded dpon dam pa zhig gyur cing*/ / bde legs kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu stor/ / kye ma kye hud 'jig rten stongs kyis med/ /dkar phyogs ye shes nyin byed nub gyur cing*/ /bdud rigs mun pa'i tshogs rnams rgyas gyur te/ /rgyal khams kun tu dus tshigs yol bar gyur/ /zhing de'i snang ba dam pa'ang nub gyur la/ /lha mi'i 'jig rten ma rig mun pas ldongs/ /thar gling sa mkhan chen po de med pas/ /da ni 'gro ba mya ngan bya ba'i rigs/ /rgyal ba dran dang mya ngan 'da' bsam pas/ /zhi ba'i gling 'gro yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /chos de tshad med legs par gsungs pa ste/ /de bas ches lhag dge tshogs rnams 'phel 'gyur/

/ kye ma kyi hud thugs rje'i dbying rum nas/ /mgon med bdag gi gdung ba'i tshig 'di gson/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal mang ldan 'khor ba pa/ /mgon med dpung gnyen bral ba'i tshogs rnams dang*/ / bdag cag dad ldan ltos pa'i skye dgu rnams/ /da ni ci bya su la re bar bya/ / bstan la mngon par lhags pa'i lha rnams dang*/ /dad ldan mi rnams mya ngan mes gdungs shing*/ /dus 'dir phan bzhed byed pa'i ljon shing chag /skyabs dang skyob pa dpung gnyen med par gyur/ /bdag cag gdul bya'i bsod nams mtsho bsil skam/ /zhi gyur rin chen bla ma dbyings su yal/ /chos kyi glang po de ring gzims par gyur/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal ye shes nyi ma nub/ /phan bde'i 'od dkar nub ri'i rgyab tu yol/ /lha mi'i bde 'byung bum pa bzang po chag /sa mkhan ded dpon rig 'dzin bla ma gshegs/ / gling bzhi 'jig rten rgyan gyur stongs so kye/ /thugs rje can yang brtse ba spongs ba bzhin/ bdag cag bor nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/ / mgon med skye dgu re zhing ltos pa rnams/ /rang bzhin dor nas yal bar 'dor phod dam/ /dus min nyi zla'i 'gros kyang ma log la/ /sa dang bar snang dag kyang ma 'tshol na/ /bdag cag rnams la dus tshig 'di lta bu/ /mya ngan gdungs pas snying la khyab par gyur/ /gang du bsams kyang ded dpon bla ma dran/ /ri rtse nags kyi mthongs dang gangs ri'i 'dabs/ /sgrub pa'i gnas mchog sngon chad dgyes dgyes pas/ /sa phyogs gang na 'ang deng nas yongs mi bzhugs/ /nye 'khor nye bar spyad pa'i tshogs mthong nas/ /dgyes pa'i spyan mchog gzigs par mdzad de'ang grongs/ /'od gsal rin chen chos nyid bsgom bsam yang*/ /dam pa'i gsung rnams dran nas mchi ma shor/ / lhar bcas 'gro ba'i bsod nams dpag bsam shing*/ /phan bde'i yal 'dab rgyas par mi mdzad par/ /dus min me tog 'bras bu skom gyur te/ / gdul bya'i bya tshogs da ni gang du bsten/

/'khor ba mi bzad sdug bsngal du ma'i phreng*/ /bsgrod dkar zhugs la brtse bas mi gzigs par/ /'jigs pa'i 'phrang las skyel mas bslus pa bzhin/ /bdag cag dor nas mgon po gang du gshegs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dang dbyed med cing*/ /dpag med mdzad pas 'gra ོ ba' ི kha lo bsgyur/ /mthong thos dran reg 'khor ba phyir bsnyil ba/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma gang du gshegs/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje gzhan las lhag gyur cing*/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las gnas rigs khyab par 'dug /spyan dang mngon shes spang rtogs phun sum tshogs/ /'phags pa'i bla ma de ring gang du gshegs/ /thugs rje'i mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i sprin 'khrigs te/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i chos chen char 'bebs pas/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i re ba skong mdzad pa/ /mchog gyur bstan pa'i rtsa lag gang du gshegs/ / mgon po gangs ri'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la/ /thugs rje zhi ba bsil ba'i rgyun babs pas/ /'gro kun nyon mongs ma ེ tshogs zhi mdzad pa/ /sa 'dzin 'jig rten gsum mgon gang du gshegs/ tshogs gnyis pad rdzing yan lag brgyad ldan nas/ /dad ldan bung ba mang po'i tshogs rnams la/ /zhi bde'i dga' ston dam pa mi 'gyed par/ /rnam grol yon tan tshogs chen gang du gshegs/ /sa gsum skye dgu zhi la bzhag go zhes/ /phan bde'i 'od stong dra ba bgyed mdzad cing*/ /'gro ba'i lam yangs dkar por mdzad pa can/ / dge legs nyin mo'i dbang phyug gang du gshegs/ /'khor tshogs dbus na cha shas gsal ba'i sku/ /byams pa'i zhal bzang lta bas mi ngoms la/ / thugs rje'i phyag gnyis 'gro la rkyong mdzad pa/ /mgon po ston zla'i dkyil 'khor gang du gshegs/ /'khor ba'i chu gter shin tu brgal dka' las/ / srid gsum rgya mtsho'i pha rol sgrol mdzad cing*/ /zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa/ /gru chen mnyen pa'i rgyal po gang du gshegs/ /thog med dus nas nye bar goms pa yis/

/'khor ba'i gcong nad shin tu sbyang dka' bar/ /zhi mdzad bdud rtsi'i gsos sman kun gyi bdag /'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal po gang du gshegs/ /nyi zla'i snang bas gsal bar ma nus pa'i/ /gti mug mun pa rmad byung sel mdzad cing*/ /gdul bya'i mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i rnam grol can/ /sngon med nam mkha'i nor bu gang du gshegs/ /rlabs chen mdzad pa thugs rje'i rang bzhin ni/ /chu srin 'dzin pa khri yis mi bskrun pa/ /'byung po 'dzin ma 'di na mtshungs pa med/ /dpag yas skye dgu'i bla ma gang du gshegs/ /mi g.yo dngas pa rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin la/ /'dod 'byung nor bu gdengs can gtsug gis rgyan/ sa steng rgyan gyur mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ / gzhan las che mchog bla ma gang du gshegs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa'i rlabs g.yo zhing*/ /'gro kun bsod nams zhing gi mchog gyur pa/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten mchod sda ོnga gang du gshegs/ /'khor gyi khyams su tshangs dbyangs seṅge'i sgra/ /dam chos rin chen char pa 'bebabs mdzad cing*/ /ma rig the tshom dra ba gcod la mkhas/ /ye shes rnga sgra'i bla ma gang du gshegs/ /chos nyid mi g.yo ting 'dzin yangs pa'i klong*/ /'od gsal nyi zla dgongs klong rgya che zhing*/ /mnyam rjes dbyer med rtag tu chos sku'i ngang*/ /dbyings rig mthar phyin bla ma gang du gshegs/ /dpag med dus nas mkhyen brtse rlabs che zhing*/ /lung rig man ngag snying po'i gang chen mtsho/ /byin rlabs dngos grub rin cen 'byung ba'i gnas/ / yon tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma gang du gshegs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las mnga' brnyes shing*/ /rlabs chen mdzad pas gdul bya gang du skyong*/ /'od gsal bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa/ /stobs chen rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gang du gshegs/ /bdag cag dad ldan 'gro la mi gzigs par/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su zhi la thugs gzhol ba/

/brtse chen thabs mkhas thugs rje gang du gshegs/ /slan chad khyed zhal mthong ba'i skabs mchis sam/ /tha ma'i mdzad pa mngon par skyo ba'i gnas/ /dge ba'i 'jig rten stong la mi gzigs sam/ /sdug bsngal mang ldan me tshogs spungs pa 'dir/ /thugs rje'i char rgyun bsil bas mi sbyong ngam/ /mgon gyur dag kyang re ba med mdzad na/ /bdag cag rnams la su zhig skyabs su gyur/ /kye ma skyabs mchog bla ma thugs rje can/ /zhi ba'i dbyings nas thugs rjes phyag rkyongs la/ /bdag cag 'gro kun de ring drang du gsol/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar gdung bas nyin mtshan gsol ba 'debs/ / gus pas phyag 'tshal rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /dus rnams rtag tu 'dren mchog mdzad du gsol/ /mtha' yas zhing dang 'gro ba ji tsam par/ /blo yis mngon sprul de dag thal sbyor te/ /dad brgya'i 'dab stong g.yo bas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ / bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod par bgyi/ /'gro ba'i mgon po shin tu thugs rje can/ / rgyan gyur 'jig rten bla ma deng shar te/ /'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa gsal mdzad nas/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rjes rtag tu 'khor ba yongs bzung ste/ /zhi ba phyogs gcig mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /'gro la phan gzigs tha ma'i mdzad pa yis/ / ngo mtshar 'jig rten khyab la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ston kha'i zla ba dang po zhi ba yis/ /nags khrod dam par sku tshe gtong ba las/ /slar yang byin rlabs thugs rjes rmad du byung*/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad par mtshungs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang du mgon po mya ngan 'das gyur pa/ /de tshe sa dang nags tshal bcas pa g.yos/ /dus min sgra dang sil snyan dpag med 'khrol/ /lha rdzas mchod pas mdzes la gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyogs rnams ston kha'i mdog bzang mdzes pa las/ /dad pa'i mkha' dbyings 'od lnga'i bla re bres/

/drwa ba drwa phyed zlum 'khrims za 'og ris/ / rab 'khyil snang ba shar la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sku gdung mchod las nyin mtshan phyad par yang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i sgra dang sil snyan gling bu dang*/ /lha rdzas rol mo 'od lnga'i snang bar bcas/ /ya mtshan mchod sprin mtho la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang la sku gdung zhugs kyis 'bar ba na/ /'od lnga'i snang bas nam mkha' khyab gyur cing*/ /'gro kun mi rtog bsam gtan sa la gnas/ /ngo mtshar snang bas khyab la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe mkha' la snyan pa'i sgra grags shing*/ /dud spṛn rtse la 'od zer tshogs shar bas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings khyab khyad par nub phyogs gsal/ / 'gro ba' ི yid rab g.yo la gus phyag 'tshal/ /thabs kyi sku gdung rgyas par mdzad pa las/ /dbu thod ril bu 'od lda'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rang byon 'od lnga'i klong na rdzogs par bzhugs/ /ngo mtshar rten du gyur la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sil bu'i gdung gzhug mchod rten bzhengs pa na'ang*/ /'od lnga'i gdugs dang bla res rgyal mtshan mchog /nam mkha'i dbyings na snang bas mdzes gyur pa/ /bsod nams zhing du gyur la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dam pa rnams kyi tshul 'di bsam mi khyab/ /srid pa ji srid phan bde mdzad pa ste/ 'di yi rlabs chen spyod pa mtha' yas pa/ /'di lta 'o zhes bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /la lar gshegs dang la lar bltams pa dang*/ /la lar mnyam gzhag la lar zhing rnams sbyong*/ /la lar don mdzad la lar bdud rnams 'dul/ /dby-ings las mi g.yo sprul pa rgyun mi chad/ /de slad bdag cag don ldan 'gro ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas zhi ba'i nags 'dabs su/ /'di yi thugs rjes myur du 'dren nges pas/ /dus med rgyun du gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa 'di dang 'ga' zhig phrad gyur te/ / gsung tsam thos dang zhal mthong skye dgu rnams/ /ngan song rnams chad thar lam byang chub rnyed/ /de sogs yon tan brjod kyis yongs mi langs/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i dad dpon bla ma la/

/bdag gzhan ma lus gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /nam mkha' mtha' klas ting 'dzin sprin tshogs kyis/ /mngon par bkang ste bla med mchod sprin bgyi/ /lus dang ngag yid sdig kun ci mchis pa/ thugs rje'i zer gyis bsal bar mdzad du gsol/ /las dang nyon mongs me tshogs ji snyed kun/ /ye shes chu bos zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /deng nas byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ khyed kyis rnam grol thugs rjes phyag rkyongs la/ /'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*/ / theg pa dman las bskyab par mdzad du gsol/ /rtag tu bshes gnyen dam pa brten byed cing*/ /'od gsal ye shes sa dang lam rdzogs nas/ /byang chub zhi ba thob par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag gang du skye ba rnam kun tu/ khyed dang mi 'bral bsgrod pa gcig pa yis/ /gzhan don rlabs chen phrin las rdzogs par shog /thugs rje'i spyan mchog dam pa dkyus ring bas/ dus rnams kun tu bdag cag gzigs mdzod la/ /nyes kun rnam sel legs dgu lhun grub nas/ /'dod dgu'i re ba rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /skyabs dang skyob pa dpung gnyen mdzad du gsol/ /mgon dang bshes dang sa mkhan mdzad du gsol/ / ye shes 'od gsal sgron me spar du gsol/ /'du 'bral med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /de ltar bdag blo mos pa'i gdung shugs kyis/ /mchog tu gus pas gsol ba btab pa yi/ / dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /'chi med mya ngan med pa'i gnas thob shog / bla ma dam pa ku ma rā dza dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe/ gdung ba'i yid dang smre sngags kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rabs pad+ma stong ldan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab phal po che la thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab legs bar sbyangs pa/ kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so//
